stories.title: Russian forces hit three dry cargo ships, two tankers at Odessa port
stories.summary: Fuel tanks were also destroyed, the Russian defense ministry said
article_sentences: Russian forces struck three dry cargo ships and two tankers, as well as fuel tanks at the port of Odessa, the Russian defense ministry said.

"Three dry cargo ships and two sea-going tankers used to deliver military cargoes and fuels for the Ukrainian army, as well as fuel tanks and warehouses holding military products were struck at the port of Odessa," it said.
stories.headline: Russian forces hit three dry cargo ships, two tankers at Odessa port

opening: Russian forces struck three dry cargo ships and two tankers, as well as fuel tanks at the port of Odessa, the Russian defense ministry said.
body: "Three dry cargo ships and two sea-going tankers used to deliver military cargoes and fuels for the Ukrainian army, as well as fuel tanks and warehouses holding military products were struck at the port of Odessa," it said.
Fuel tanks were also destroyed, the Russian defense ministry said.
